nodes.name: int_ais_mmsi_map
nodes.description: Every MMSI used by a fleet ship during the AIS window.

nodes.name: int_ais_stops_located
nodes.description: Stop episodes classified as berth, anchored or stopped at sea and tied to a port.

nodes.name: int_ais_stop_episodes
nodes.description: Stop episodes from track steps (gaps and islands).

nodes.name: int_ais_track
nodes.description: AIS positions with step time and distance.

nodes.name: int_fleet_ships
nodes.description: One row per fleet ship with its salted-hash pseudonym and durable ship_key.

nodes.name: int_port_calls
nodes.description: Port calls with waiting time before berthing.

nodes.name: int_ship_capacity
nodes.description: Gross tonnage per ship, reported or estimated from AIS dimensions, with calibration statistics.

nodes.name: int_ship_identity
nodes.description: Fleet ships linked to AIS identity and dimensions.

nodes.name: int_ship_year
nodes.description: Ship-year metrics with EU ETS exposure and CII rating.

nodes.name: int_track_weather
nodes.description: Under-way positions with hourly wind and wave values.

nodes.name: dim_date
nodes.description: Calendar table, one row per day from 2018-01-01 to the data end date. Marked as the date table in Power BI.

nodes.name: dim_port
nodes.description: Norwegian ports at UN/LOCODE level from the Kystverket location register.

nodes.name: dim_segment
nodes.description: The two fleet segments, vehicle carriers and ro-ro ships, with a plain description.

nodes.name: dim_ship
nodes.description: Pseudonymous ship dimension, slowly changing type 2. One row per ship version. A new version starts when segment, flag region, flag state, ice class or technical index type changes between reporting years. No ship names, IMO numbers or call

nodes.name: fct_daily_carbon_price
nodes.description: Grain is one row per day. EU ETS allowance price, EUR per tonne CO2.

nodes.name: fct_port_call
nodes.description: Grain is one row per AIS-derived port call in Norway (ship, port, berth period), with anchorage waiting time.

nodes.name: fct_ship_year_emissions
nodes.description: Grain: one row per ship and MRV reporting year. Fuel, CO2, distance, time at sea, speed, EU ETS exposure and the CII rating (approximation on the MRV scope).

nodes.name: fct_voyage_leg
nodes.description: Grain is one row per voyage leg between consecutive port calls, with track distance, speed and weather.

nodes.name: stg_ais__positions
nodes.description: AIS positions of fleet ships.

nodes.name: stg_ais__static
nodes.description: AIS static records for fleet ships.

nodes.name: stg_carbon__eua_daily
nodes.description: Daily EU ETS allowance price.

nodes.name: stg_kystverket__locations
nodes.description: Kystverket location register.

nodes.name: stg_kystverket__port_calls
nodes.description: Kystverket port call records, de-duplicated, times in UTC.

nodes.name: stg_kystverket__tonnage
nodes.description: Reported tonnage used for size calibration.

nodes.name: stg_mrv__ship_year
nodes.description: EU MRV reports for ro-ro ships and vehicle carriers with harmonised column names across the 2018 and 2024 formats.

nodes.name: stg_weather__waves
nodes.description: Hourly waves per grid cell.

nodes.name: stg_weather__wind
nodes.description: Hourly wind per grid cell.

nodes.name: cii_rating_boundaries
nodes.description: IMO CII rating boundary vectors (exp(d1) to exp(d4)) that split attained CII / required CII into ratings A to E.

nodes.name: cii_reduction_factors
nodes.description: IMO CII reduction factors Z relative to the 2019 reference line, by rating year.

nodes.name: cii_reference_lines
nodes.description: IMO CII reference line parameters (CII_ref = a * capacity^-c) for the two fleet segments, with capacity bands.

nodes.name: eu_ets_phase_in
nodes.description: EU ETS phase-in for shipping: the share of verified emissions of a year for which allowances must be surrendered. Methane and nitrous oxide are added from the 2026 emission year.

nodes.name: eu_ets_scope_rules
nodes.description: Share of emissions counted under the EU ETS by voyage type (intra-EEA, at berth, voyages to or from outside the EEA).

nodes.name: fuel_assumptions
nodes.description: Documented scenario inputs (fuel price, default carbon price). Every assumption is a parameter the user can change.

nodes.name: registry_port_flag
nodes.description: Maps the MRV "port of registry" to its flag state and a broad flag region. Unmapped ports fall into "Other or unknown".

nodes.name: mrv_ship_year
nodes.description: EU MRV (THETIS-MRV) public emission reports, one row per ship and reporting year, all ship types.

nodes.name: eua_daily
nodes.description: Daily EU ETS allowance price (front December contract, EUR per tonne CO2) from Ember.

nodes.name: ais_static
nodes.description: AIS static ship records for the MRV fleet, used only to link IMO numbers to MMSI and ship dimensions.

nodes.name: ais_positions
nodes.description: AIS positions of fleet ships on the Norwegian coast, thinned to one position per two minutes.

nodes.name: kystverket_port_calls
nodes.description: Kystverket port call records (time in port per ship and location), all ship types.

nodes.name: tonnage_calibration
nodes.description: Reported gross tonnage and deadweight of ro-ro ships and vehicle carriers from Kystverket port call records.

nodes.name: kystverket_locations
nodes.description: Kystverket register of Norwegian harbours, port facilities, quays and anchorages.

nodes.name: weather_wind
nodes.description: Hourly 10 m wind from the Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5), per 0.25 degree cell.

nodes.name: weather_waves
nodes.description: Hourly significant wave height from the Open-Meteo Marine Weather API, per 0.5 degree cell.
